ossos.required_evidence: Maintainer-certified corrected 15AP/15AM/15BS/15BT/15BC/15BD efficiency files and complete pointings, each with canonical URL, version, byte count, and SHA-256.
One finite manifest covering eight sky regions, ten characterization components, and eleven published footprint rows.

Documented explanation of the 2019 bad-directory withdrawal plus an authoritative corrected/native later-component detection file, or deterministic reconstruction recipe, with canonical URL, version, byte count, SHA-256, resolution of the 605-versus-607 count and IDs o5c114/o5t58, and parity to the 840-row publication catalog.
Locked detection-level versus physical-object semantics and the six cross-survey alias pairs, preserving survey-stratum provenance.
Locked filter/color model, characterization limit, linking, tracking, lost-object, and exclusion semantics.

Authoritative mapping from the named survey release to one simulator commit plus exact source/archive, build, compiler, native-dependency, runtime, RNG, driver/seed, and qualification-manifest bindings with a separately locked compatibility/parity test.

Explicit software license for the exact historical simulator snapshot and explicit data-license and redistribution terms for catalogs, efficiencies, pointings, detection files, and derived archives; a current-repository EUPL notice is not silently inherited by historical code or data.
Content-addressed durable archive with independent byte/hash and semantic/count audit receipt.

des.required_evidence: Choose and lock one catalog release and H_r version, with the 814/812 final-release versus 817/815 manuscript-prose discrepancy explicitly resolved.
Lock the nc, Centaur, Oort-cloud-comet, and count-likelihood eligibility rules.
Lock orbit epoch/time scale, state frame, covariance use, uncertainty propagation, and ephemeris backend.
Resolve 76,217 paper exposures versus 76,162 simulator positions and 76,226 CCD-corner exposure IDs.
Lock griz-only discovery behavior, colors/bandpasses, the 0.95529 transient factor, and the 60/90-day distance-dependent triplet rule.
Acquire or formally account for raw transient, fake-injection, linkage, candidate, inclusion, and confirmation lineage.
Lock simulator and orbitspp versions, dependencies, RNG implementation and streams, tests, environment, software/data licenses, and independent qualification gates.
Content-addressed durable archive with independent byte/hash, FITS schema/count, covariance, and selection parity audit receipt.

matched_model_acceptance_requirements.required_evidence: Canonical binary and decoded common physical checkpoint with particle IDs/order/weights, Sun and known-body states, epoch, time standard, frame, origin, units, byte count, SHA-256, source, version, license, and archive.

Paired M0/M1 decks and a machine-derived semantic diff proving that checkpoint particles, known-body history, tides/stars, code, integrator, cadence, loss rules, nuisance model, and random streams are identical and only the registered compact body differs.
Finite M1 family with mass and complete six-dimensional phase state, epoch/frame/origin/units, immutable weights, selection lineage, and locked powered region.
Physical source-population generator, exact initial particles, known-body migration and cluster history, compact-body emplacement time/state/algorithm, and estimand boundary.
Locked RNG algorithm/version, future public beacon, canonical seed derivation and encoding, stream namespace, replicate counts, common-random-number mapping, and failure/retry record.
Source, build, native dependency, container, input-deck, license, and redistribution hashes for both arms.
Checkpoint/output inventory with exact finite counts, byte sizes, hashes, semantic identities, cadence, loss/event logs, and replay receipt.
Independent audit proving no candidate-9118 row, state, fingerprint, derivative, or outcome-tuned selection enters the family, checkpoint, prior, grid, or weights.
Explicit previously-inspected exposure ledger and claim boundary or a genuinely untouched holdout with custodian evidence.
Locked integration duration, timestep or adaptive-step controls, numerical tolerances, sample/checkpoint cadence, loss boundaries, and predeclared numerical adequacy gates for every arm.
Locked survival, removal, resonance, stability, classification, and censoring rules, including deterministic handling of failures and ambiguous states.
Complete intrinsic absolute-magnitude, color, size, albedo, and correlation nuisance model with finite normalization, immutable parameters or weights, selection lineage, and propagation rules.
Content-addressed model-to-survey forward-adapter binding with exact convention transforms, version compatibility, parity fixtures, and fail-closed interface checks.

Immutable phase and orientation uncertainty policy: complete angles with epoch/frame or a preregistered finite grid or joint prior, fixed weights, symmetry validation, and no adaptive or outcome-conditioned selection.

Locked hardware architecture and device model, compiler and flags, numerical libraries, determinism settings, worker topology, and reduction order, with a documented cross-hardware reproducibility policy.

mandatory_nonclaim: This checklist and local custody package do not complete JX-O2 G0, authorize any simulation or observed-data execution, compare models, or provide evidence for or against Planet X.
